KM003C active whitelisted-read capture, 2026-11-16
Format: plain hex, space separated, one frame per file.
Naming: <transport>_<step>_<n>_<kind>.hex; transport = bulk (IF0 EP01/81), hid (IF3), cdc (/dev/cu.usbmodem0500022).
Request ids come from ONE global counter starting at 1 (bulk 1-14, hid 15-17, cdc 18-20).
HID *_req.hex files hold the 65-byte hidapi buffer: leading 0x00 is the report-ID byte, NOT sent on the wire (wire = 64 B).
No drain/stray/trailing transfer carried data, so no *_drain_* / *_stray_* files exist
(the only non-timeout drain results were 0-byte ZLPs after each MemoryRead data transfer; see active_bulk_log.json).
